work.description: The act renews the censures on the usurpers in the Legations. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX. — PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF131-135) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF4957-4958 reads: ALLOCUTIO HABITA IN CONSISTORIO SRCBETO DIE 960 SEPTEMBRIS MDCCCLIX. Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. OCR prints DIE 960; Whole native page image (see validation native_page_images) read where the OCR numeral is garbled; the OCR literal is unchanged. (leaf 134: DIE 26 SEPTEMBRIS MDCCCLIX). Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
